sampling.interpolation: local translation lerp and shortest-arc local quaternion SLERP before forward kinematics

coordinateSystem.bodyHeightDefinition: Head End Site Y minus lower LeftToeBase/RightToeBase Y in source setup frame 0
coordinateSystem.rootMotion: separate rootTrack arrays are displacement relative to first crop/loop frame in body heights

loopCorrection.method: local quaternion overlap crossfade, quintic smoothstep
loopCorrection.description: Derived review loop: tail of 4s crop crossfades with first .4s, natural 3.6s cycle slowed to 4s. Original frames retained separately.

limitations: Not native Spine motion or artistic approval.
First source frame is a synthetic setup pose, excluded from crop.
CMU fingers/thumbs were not captured; hand/toe tracks can be noisy.
Crossfade may cause contact drift; no contact solver or cloth/face tracks are supplied.
Quaternion interpolation is piecewise SLERP; source velocity kinks remain. A zero pose seam does not certify a zero velocity seam.
Camera and window ranking are numerical heuristics, requiring visual review.
